assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is performed with CPT code 93229.
The documented diagnosis codes are I25.10 and I34.0.
The service is medically necessary to detect intermittent arrhythmias and guide continued rate-control therapy.
